comparisonContract.rootCause: Every candidate has exactly one expected root diagnostic and expected phase.
comparisonContract.candidates: Candidate facts are compared against the visible scope and are bounded to five or fewer spelling candidates.
comparisonContract.uniqueRepair: A text edit is allowed only for a single close spelling candidate; the emitted span is applied and the repaired query must analyze successfully.
comparisonContract.abstention: Ambiguous, missing-metadata, unsupported, and out-of-scope cases must have no structured TextEdit.
comparisonContract.explanation: Every diagnostic retains a non-empty explanation and documentation reference.
comparisonContract.scope: Names exposed by a separate provider must not appear in the Basic provider candidate facts.

revisionHistory.reason: Compile-only correction: the public MSTest entry point now receives object and casts the private frozen case record; candidate cases and expectations are unchanged.
